snippet.title: Cursed Blood Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Cursed Blood is a brutal 1-4 player co-op melee roguelike. Play as vengeful Samurai Apes fueled by rage, unleashing a whirlwind of lightning-fast combat.

Play the demo today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3382290/Cursed_Blood/
